verdict.rationale: Orb's first-party docs have a dedicated SDK page stating official SDKs ship in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, and Ruby. The API they wrap documents idempotency, cursor pagination and machine-readable errors. missing for 10: SDK-specific reference depth (installation, typed models, versioning, retry/pagination helpers), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Orb's SDK is available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Kotlin, and Ruby.
Orb's API supports idempotency, to allow safe request retries without duplicating actions.
The Orb API implements cursor-based pagination on endpoints that list resources
